verdicts.correction: By default (Prefer natural words = on), guided lessons use real dictionary words from the allowed letters and fall back to pseudo-words only when few match, mostly at the start. The default unlock rule needs every included letter to have reached target speed at least once (best confidence), not to be green now. Older letters can be red and the next letter still unlocks. Only the opt-in recoverKeys requires current confidence. The target letter is the included key with the lowest best-ever confidence, not the currently slowest key.
